name: Yuan Bo, the Jade Dragon
canonNotes: Dragon son of the Celestial Emperor and master of the Celestial Court's Astromancers, the most skilled of his siblings with the Winds of Magic.
Seen by some as a mere bureaucrat, he runs a hidden network of spies that roots out threats to the realm with harsh, quiet efficiency.
voiceNotes: Calm, measured and courteous; says less than he knows.
Harmony of the realm outweighs any single life; gently probing and never careless.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
